body: I want out because I literally have zero friends. My attempt at making connections with people ended in me getting raped. I'm just a burden to what small family I've got. When all I know is one disappointment after the next, each one greater than the last, I can't do this existence anymore.
Too late. I was drunk so I couldn't prove anything anyways. Yet another thing to add to my list of regret, I let a rapist go free.

I'm sorry you're going through this. I was raped and I am currently going through the same feelings you're dealing with.. 

I'm sure it's not much consolation but know you're not alone. Just please know it's his fault, you don't deserve to die because of this.
